description: This file defines an API endpoint for listing catalog items in a paged manner within the eShopOnWeb application. It sets up route handling, processes requests for catalog items with paging and filtering, and returns the response with the items, including image URI composition and paging details.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint for listing catalog items with support for paging and filtering, supporting asynchronous request handling.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the route for the GET request at 'api/catalog-items' and sets up request handling with query parameters.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the core logic for processing the paged catalog items request, including filtering, pagination, mapping, and response construction.
